items.fact: The attacker-influenced value first enters via `data_copy, length` in fuzz_parse_http_request.

Root cause / required safety condition: The vulnerable program dispatches the final `Cont` line to the Content branch and advances p without proving that seven bytes remain before end. The fixed program enforces this guard through HEADER_LENGTH("Content"); on the original PoC that leaves the required assertion guarded, and the single boundary perturbation `content_name_boundary` supplies the genuine witness where the conjunct holds and the protected inner switch executes.
Propagation: The out-of-range pointer produced by the unchecked Content advance is the same pointer the immediate inner STRING_SWITCH_L(p) uses as its switch argument.
Propagation: The Content-family branch transforms p by adding the seven-byte Content name length; the resulting address is exactly the post-advance p observed before the inner switch.
